Panchayat fame Faisal Malik graces the stage of . He sits down to share anecdotes from the making of Panchayat, how he was star-struck upon meeting Shah Rukh Khan for the first time, what advice does he have for those portraying Anurag Kashyap in negative light. Watch the video to know the release date of Panchayat 5 and would his character Prahlad Cha contest election.
